summary: Diff implements several frontend theme/animation updates, adds backend alert storage and frontend hooks for alerts, and updates Market Intel hooks. However, evidence is insufficient that Market Intel randomness was fully removed/isolated (REQ-4) and that site-wide interval/live-update cleanup was completed (REQ-9). Diff also introduces several unrequested UX/content elements such as emoji-based navigation ticker, simulated protocol tickers, and a specific WhatsApp redirection number.

missing_requirements.requirement: Improve Market Intel accuracy/consistency by removing or clearly isolating simulated/randomized market inputs (esp. forex 24h change/volume simulation and Date.now-seeded randomness) so signals are stable when underlying fetched data is unchanged.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary mentions "stabilized Market Intel with time-window rounding" but does not provide concrete evidence that randomized/simulated inputs (including forex simulation or Date.now-based seeding) were removed from calculations or clearly isolated/marked unavailable. Truncated code does not show the indicator/signal generation logic changes needed to verify this acceptance criterion.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (Market Intel summary references stabilization but not explicit randomness removal)

missing_requirements.requirement: Audit and fix site-wide real-time/live-update behaviors so intervals/timeouts are cleaned up, loading states are correct, and updates do not cause UI flicker/disappearing content or excessive network calls.
missing_requirements.reason: While SmokySectionTransition cleans up its timeout and respects reduced-motion, the diff does not show evidence of auditing/fixing periodic polling/interval patterns across the real-time sections (e.g., Market Pulse, AI sentiment simulations, Market Intel refresh intervals) to prevent duplicate intervals or multiplied requests after navigation.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (mentions simulated/dynamic values in multiple sections but does not show interval cleanup changes)
